              Stock Connect Southbound Shareholding Search By Date

              Shanghai Connect and Shenzhen Connect

              Shareholding information displayed represents the shareholdings of China Securities Depository and Clearing (CCASS Participant ID: A00003 and A00004) in aggregate as at the end of the specified date. If the specified shareholding date is a Sunday or a Hong Kong public holiday, shareholding information on the preceding day which is not a Sunday or Hong Kong public holiday will be displayed.

              Shareholding information is available starting from 17 March 2017 and will be made available on this website for 12 months from the shareholding date.
